inputs.name: simulated Hn ratios
inputs.cite: R4 G2c Results table and verdict line (quoted, not re-simulated)

day.reading: MITTENS models parallel fixation, so a strictly serial premise does not describe it
day.holds: neither 1/1,322 per generation nor ~146 concurrent sweeps erodes unlinked diversity (0.97-1.03)

critic.reading: a strictly serial sweep model predicts almost no standing variation
critic.holds: true by construction of a strictly serial model; unlinked diversity is set by theta = 4 Ne mu

notes: theta = 4 Ne mu has no sweep-rate term, so unlinked neutral diversity is not removed by sweeps; only linked sites (hitchhiking, not in R4 G2c) are. The fitness-variance route would need about 1e6 concurrent sweeps for Var(w) of order 10 (closed form here; R4 G2c P4). The ratios are simulation results quoted from R4 G2c: 0.97-1.03 (A) and 1.00-1.01 (B, 146 concurrent, 0.64x of 230); the post hoc B2 rerun at about 228 concurrent gave 0.970-0.981. The conditional is correct for a strictly serial model, which neither side's stated model is.
